description: Run the mechanical elimination screen against an operating company's own SEC filings. It is not applicable to ETFs, funds or indices; use compose_research_brief so those instruments are classified and routed correctly. No language model is involved: seven hard rules (10y ROE, 5y cumulative FCF, interest cover, gross margin, OCF/NI, net margin, dilution) with three exemptions, and every rejection names the metric, value and threshold. Missing rules are skipped, never passes. Surviving is not a recommendation. US operating-company filers only.

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only filings actually filed by this date are used, which is what keeps a historical screen free of look-ahead bias.

cik.description: SEC CIK. Use list_us_universe to resolve a ticker.

ticker.description: US ticker, e.g. MU. Resolved to a CIK against the SEC universe, so supplying this is enough.
